name: the campaigns page offers a new campaign
a campaign with no audience to pick explains what one is, where the choice is made
the explainer offers to create the audience the campaign needs
the campaign sends the user to Contacts and says where to come back to
the half-filled campaign is kept while the audience is built
the save control appears, labelled, once there is something to save
the save dialog asks for a name
saving the audience lands back on the campaign, carrying it
the campaign comes back with what was typed into it
and with the audience just built already chosen
